question.title: Binary Number to String LCCI
question.content:
Given a real number between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.72) that is passed in as a double, print the binary representation. If the number cannot be represented accurately in binary with at most 32 characters, print "ERROR".

Example1:

 Input: 0.625
 Output: "0.101"

Example2:

 Input: 0.1
 Output: "ERROR"
 Note: 0.1 cannot be represented accurately in binary.

Note:

  • This two charaters "0." should be counted into 32 characters.
  • The number of decimal places for num is at most 6 digits

示例 1：

输入：0.625
输出："0.101"

示例 2：

输入：0.1
输出："ERROR"
提示：0.1 无法被二进制准确表示

 

提示：

  • 32位包括输出中的 "0." 这两位。
  • 题目保证输入用例的小数位数最多只有 6 位
